description: Append-only SHA-256 chain audit log with thread-safe operations and a context citation lock. Supports hot (hash-only) and cold (chained) modes. ContextCitationLock enforces proof-of-citation: claimed values must appear verbatim in a corpus stream.
function: SHA-256 chain append-only audit log, context citation lock

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: File path for persistent JSONL ledger (None for in-memory)

inputs.name: gate
inputs.description: Pre-condition gate; defaults to all-ready gate

inputs.name: audit
inputs.description: If True, use chained mode for this entry (keyword-only)

inputs.name: corpus
inputs.description: Stream of text chunks to search for citations

inputs.name: quoted_value
inputs.description: Value to search for in corpus (has_citation)

inputs.name: exact
inputs.description: If True, use re.escape for exact match (default True)

outputs.name: AuditLedger.log
outputs.description: Entry dict with event_hash (and prev_hash in chained mode)

outputs.name: ContextCitationLock.has_citation
outputs.description: True if value found verbatim in corpus

outputs.name: ContextCitationLock.require_citation
outputs.description: Raises ValueError if citation not found
